text:
jess: Heads-up — prototyping a QoS-aware surge sequencer for the synthetic traffic generator. Goal: exercise kernel selection + batching heuristics while triggering KV cache warm/cold transitions so we can surface pathological fallbacks. sketch below.

omar: Love it. What's the target SLOs and which perf counters do you want from the runtime?

jess: Target SLOs: p99 < 120ms (interactive tier), p99.9 < 400ms for bursty high-priority. Counters: batch_size_hist, kernel_choice_events, kv_hit_rate, kv_eviction_events, cpu/gpu_op_times. Also need per-request routing tag so we can correlate sequencer decisions with kernel switches.

cheng: Can we include a prefix-length sweep? KV invalidation happens mostly when prefix len > 512 for our transformer sharded layout. Would like a stratified workload: 60% short (<64), 30% mid (64-512), 10% long (>512).

jess: Exactly — plan is staged ramps + short microbursts inside long-tail segments. Config sketch:
```
qos:
  priority_bands: ["low", "med", "high"]
  burst_window_ms: 250
  ramp_profile: "log+hold"
  kernel_hint: "prefer_fp16_if_latency<=30ms"
  sample_prefix_distribution: "stratified:60,30,10"
  kv_warmup: 50ms
```

omar: That kernel_hint logic worries me — runtime currently does a latency estimate based on last 100 samples, mixing sequence lengths could flip kernel choices mid-batch. We should log kernel_choice_events with reason_code.

perf-bot: auto-report: quick profiling run (seed=42, 10k reqs) 
- p50: 12ms  p95: 58ms  p99: 122ms
- kernel_switch_count: 37
- top kernel callers: aten_fp16_gemm (54%), qint8_gemm (28%), fallback_fp32_conv (18%)
- kv_miss_rate: 0.087

sam: Noted a regression on Friday — kernel selection fallback to qint8 for seq>1024 caused a 2x p99 spike. Might be related to the kernel_hint override. We need deterministic reproducer.

cheng: Reproducer command (local harness):
```
./synthgen replay \n  --seed 42 \n  --ramp 0:5000:600s \n  --burst-pattern "spike:3x200@500s" \n  --prefix-dist stratified:60,30,10 \n  --trace-id ${TRACE_ID} \n  --emit-metrics prometheus://localhost:9091/metrics
```

jess: Perf checklist: 1) add kernel_choice_reason tags, 2) expose per-kv-key TTL/hotness in logs, 3) capture batch_size distribution with timebins, 4) attach trace_id to kernel profile dumps.

maria: Suggested metrics to add to the dashboard (short list): ["p95", "p99", "batch_size_distribution", "kernel_switch_count", "kv_miss_rate", "tail_coalescing_time", "queue_delay_ms"]. Also add an alert if kernel_switch_count spikes > 5/min for a given model.

omar: For apples-to-apples comparisons we should normalize CPU/GPU kernel timings by effective token work (tokens * heads * dim/ffn_ratio). That avoids comparing different sequence mixtures unfairly.

sam: I'll pin down the Friday regression. Plan: run 8h noise-run with and w/o qos sequencer, diff kernel_choice_events and kernel profile flame outputs.

jess: Assignments: jess -> update synthgen to emit kernel_choice_reason + trace_id. omar -> add normalized timing exporter and dashboard panels. cheng -> run reproducer w/seed 42 and upload profile tarballs. sam -> run long noise-run and produce comparison. maria -> add alerts and dashboard.

omar: timeline?

jess: Aim for initial runs by EOD tomorrow, full 8h comparison by Friday. If anyone hits a blocker ping @eng-runtime and drop the trace_id here. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: scheduled job created: /jobs/synth-qos-seq-2053001234 (status: queued)

cheng: I'll start with a short 30m smoke to validate metrics names then kick off the long one.

jess: Perfect — thanks team. Keep updates tight (one-liners).
